appearance_facts.fact: Blue solid line with circular markers; label 0-14 years (%); starts high in 2010, declines through 2020.
Red dashed line with square markers; label 65 years + (%); starts low in 2010, rises through 2020.
At the 2014 tick, the blue 0-14 marker is visibly higher on the page than the red 65+ marker.
Blue 0-14 marker at 2014 lies below its 2013 marker and above its 2015 marker.
Red 65+ marker at 2014 lies above its 2013 marker and below its 2015 marker.

public_definitions: Compare the 2014 population share for 0-14 years and 65 years +.
Open the age-group public services planning follow-up record for the group with the larger 2014 share.
Routing criterion: Larger 2014 age-group population share shown in the dashboard.
uncertain: No numeric value is printed directly at the 2014 markers; the comparison relies on the relative page positions of the 2014 markers.
The two series use different y-axes (left vs right), so absolute percentage values cannot be directly compared from the printed axis scales without additional calibration.
